n6f6c47cf97.headline: Italy: 0.9% growth in 2018, public deficit at 2.1%
n6f6c47cf97.summary: Italy's GDP grew 0.9% in 2018, but the country entered a technical recession in the second half of the year, according to the National Institute of Statistics (Istat).
n6f6c47cf97.why: Italy is a major Eurozone economy; its growth and recession signals impact European economic outlook and investor sentiment.
n6f6c47cf97.why_moved: Italy's GDP growth slowdown and technical recession raised concerns about Eurozone economic stability, affecting European markets.

na486c490b7.headline: Guatemala was the top recipient of remittances in 2018, according to Cepal
na486c490b7.summary: Improved U.S. economic conditions and employment recovery for Central American migrants boosted remittances to Central America in 2018, with Guatemala as the top recipient.
na486c490b7.why: Remittances are a critical source of foreign income for Central American economies, influencing consumption and economic stability.
